_readme: Fixed floors for eval_logs metrics, checked by src/eval/check_regression.py on every PR. Computed on the latest logged run per model. These exist to catch code regressions (a broken feature join, a label bug, a flipped sign) -- not to certify these models as clinically useful (n=129/11 positives, see README).

rag_knn._note: KNOWN ISSUE: current measured roc_auc=0.399 is already below random (0.5), a pre-existing weakness in the retrieval path. This is a 'no further regression' floor on the current baseline, non-blocking so the gate can ship without hiding or blocking on an unrelated issue. Flip to blocking once the retrieval path is fixed and re-baselined.
